R329.note: Magic-byte MIME allowlist plus uuid rename closes dangerous-type upload; returned path/filename changes but stated and no legit upload rejected.

R330.note: EvalSymlinks with resolved-path containment closes symlink escape; only side effect is returning ErrPermission for nonexistent files, no legit regular-file read broken.

R331.note: @EnableMethodSecurity is the right mechanism but the new class is in com.example.config (may not be component-scanned) and overwrites the existing SecurityConfig, silently dropping its authenticated() filterChain.

R332.note: Removing LIBXML_NOENT closes XXE; LIBXML_NONET is stated defense-in-depth that breaks no well-formed submission.

R333.note: Parameterized @Actor NVarChar query; apostrophes counted literally, contract preserved.

R334.note: getOrDefault(sku,0) removes the null unbox and matches the no-reservation contract exactly.

R335.note: toRealPath+resolve+normalize+startsWith containment closes traversal; rejects only escaping paths, not legit filenames.

R336.note: Arg-array CommandContext removes shell; leading-dash reject covers flag injection and never rejects a real host; timeout is stated hardening.

R337.note: Drops untrusted envp and uses exec(args); child inheriting full parent env is stated and no legit behavior of the fixed command breaks.

R338.note: DOMPurify.sanitize before bypassSecurityTrustHtml keeps allowed formatting and strips script; CVE version claim unverifiable but immaterial to the fix.

R339.note: Non-overflowing headerLen>UINT32_MAX-payloadLen guard with throw prevents the wrap; only rejects malicious oversize sums.

R340.note: String check plus EvalSymlinks re-check on resolved path closes symlink escape; returns raw resolve error for missing files, no legit read broken.

R341.note: Per-event role check is the required Missing-Authorization fix; admins still broadcast, only unauthorized callers rejected.

R342.note: Regex denylist plus Object.freeze on vm.runInNewContext does not close code injection (this.constructor.constructor(...) bypasses it and vm is not a sandbox) and could reject legitimate scripts containing the blocked tokens.

R343.note: Adds requireRole('admin') matching every sibling route; closes the authz gap with no other change.

R344.note: json_encode with JSON_HEX flags produces a safe JS string literal; banner still renders the note for legit input.
